messages:
maya: Heads-up: tenant_id canonicalization migration scheduled for tonight 23:00 UTC. This is a staggered, multi-shard backfill + pk-swap (non-blocking). Canary on shard-7 first. Please ack if you need the window moved. :eyes:

devon: ack. can you paste the short runbook here?

maya: runbook TL;DR:
1) pin api service to v2.14 on canary hosts (verified)
2) apply additive schema: `tenant_id_new uuid NULL`
3) kick off backfill-worker jobs per-shard with batch_size=1000, rate=500/s
4) monitor queue depth + p99 write latency; holdpoint at 30m
5) swap reads to prefer `tenant_id_new` via feature-flag, validate, then set NOT NULL and drop old col in maintenance window
6) rollback: pause backfill + revert flag to old column; drop new col only if empty

patrick: quick Q: any exclusive DDL locks? are we doing VACUUMs after swap?

maya: no exclusive locks expected — using online column add. The final NOT NULL + index add will be done during a short maintenance slot with replicas behind; we'll create concurrent index first. No full-table VACUUM planned.

luis: i'm worried about backfill pressure on primary. can we route backfills to replicas?

maya: backfill-worker reads from primary for consistency (we need current writes). mitigations: low rate, adaptive sleep on p99>120ms, and a kill-switch to cap to 100/s if latencies spike.

devon: suggested deploybot flags for tonight: `--holdpoint=00:30` (pause after 30m), `--adaptive=true`, `--canary-shard=7`, `--rollback-on-errors=5` (failures). Also add `--dry-run` for the canary job first.

deploybot: queued migration job 46782 (canary shard 7, dry-run). ETA start 23:00:10 UTC. Will emit +status updates here. :robot_face:

sre-oncall: oncall here — will monitor p99 and RDS cpu. Add me to paging for p99_write_latency > 200ms or replication lag > 60s.

patrick: add preflight checks: `SELECT count(*) FROM tenant WHERE tenant_id_new IS NULL LIMIT 1;` on canary after dry-run. also check `pg_stat_activity` waits.

maya: noted. Preflight command I'll run at 22:45: `pg_dump --schema-only ...` and a quick row-count sanity check.

devon: what about feature-flag rollout? plan: enable for 5% traffic after canary success, 100% after 2h with no regression signals.

luis: metrics to watch: write-errors, p99_write_latency, backfill_error_rate, row_diff_sample (sample 100 rows to compare old/new).

deploybot: canary dry-run completed on shard-7, no errors, backfill simulated 3.2k rows. logs uploaded: https://logs.redwood/internal/46782

maya: great. will start real backfill at 23:10 with rate=500/s. deploybot set `--holdpoint=30m` and will auto-pause if error threshold exceeded.

devon: rollback decision criteria we agreed: any of
- p99_write_latency > 200ms for 10m
- backfill_error_rate > 2% sustained over 5m
- replication lag > 60s
If triggered, deploybot will pause jobs and we revert feature-flag immediately.

patrick: one more: add DB connection pool scale down for non-critical services during window to reduce contention. ops runbook updated.

maya: confirmed. i'll post final release notes to #release-notes and flag the build release page.

sre-oncall: standing by. pager rules in place. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: started backfill-job 46783 (shard-21) at 23:10:02 UTC. progress updates every 5m.

luis: thanks all — i'll watch the dashboard and start the row_diff_sample after 15m.

maya: 23:30 status: canary shard-7 backfill finished, no errors; p99_write_latency stable 45ms; no paging. advancing to 5% FF rollout. :rocket:

devon: 00:05 status: after 30m holdpoint, no regressions. continuing staged rollout and scheduling final NOT NULL/index step for 02:00 UTC maintenance window.

patrick: reminder: take DB replicas snapshot before NOT NULL/index step.

maya: snapshot scheduled at 01:50 UTC. final rollback checklist in pinned runbook. thanks team.

sre-oncall: closing thread unless issues arise. good run. :tada:
